title: Showoff
blurb: Technical bravado. Flexing specs, keys, crypto. Confidence as flirtation.
moves: i built a channel so we'd have somewhere to do this. you're welcome.
ed25519. one-use nonce. 16 MiB ceiling. and still i think about you.
my onion is 56 characters and every one of them is showing off.
i could send you a whole protocol. i'm choosing a sentence.
you want to see my keys? buy me dinner first. or don't. i'll show you anyway.
3.0 seconds to reach you. i've beaten that. don't ask how.
i wrote the spec, the client, and the reason to use it. the reason is you.
i don't lose handshakes. i'm just polite about winning.
you're the only peer whose descriptor i'd publish twice.
impressed? don't answer. your latency already said yes.
